purpose: 唯一的主张级证据 authority 与 supersession 账本。它锁定各主张当前可用证据、样本/队列、推断边界、允许措辞和下一 gate；它不授权改稿，也不把局部 PASS 等同于整体 readiness。
authority_rules: 按 claim 与 estimand 选唯一当前 authority；不把不同 cohort、条件身份、二维/三维端点或 backbone 的估计合并。
事前注册、未解盲、独立 cohort 且 provenance 完整的主张优先；事后读取、历史或开发数据只作 bounded supplement/discovery。
strict-276 的 GC3-GFL 是已反复查看的同 cohort 回顾性配对复评，不是新的 independent held-out confirmation；缺失输入张量哈希时不得声称 bit-identical realization。
FRESH_CONFIRM_B 的 LLH 结果只支持 LLH 对比，不替代 C3；E1/E2 是 post-B 固定 48 对象敏感性，不是新对象确认。
image-space、GLB-native base-color、human preference 和 seam evidence 独立记录，不互相替代。
MV-Adapter 与 MVDiffusion 分别陈述；conditioning interface 与 intervention geometry 不同，禁止分数池化或架构因果归因。
历史措辞不得删除而应通过 supersedes 标签保留；本账本中的 allowed_wording 才是后续改稿默认措辞。

source_policy.integrity: Each local source path is recorded with SHA-256 as observed at ledger creation.
source_policy.downstream_docs: The reviewer matrix and claim closure matrix are downstream interpretation documents and are deliberately not treated as primary data sources here.

external_prior_art.title: Scheduled Style Injection: Expanding the Style-Content Pareto Frontier in Training-Free Diffusion-based Style Transfer
external_prior_art.consequence: Direct prior art for depth/timestep scheduling of StyleID and geometric ControlNet strength; narrow novelty claims. Does not establish adequacy of the remaining domain-specific contribution.

external_prior_art.title: Paint3D: Paint Anything 3D with Lighting-Less Texture Diffusion Models
external_prior_art.consequence: Representative end-to-end 3D texture method; its claims are paired with dedicated UV refinement modules, benchmark comparisons, user evaluation and ablations.

external_prior_art.title: Paint-it: Text-to-Texture Synthesis via Deep Convolutional Texture Map Optimization and Physically-Based Rendering
external_prior_art.consequence: Representative PBR texture-generation method; supports relighting/material application claims with the produced PBR maps and targeted comparisons.

external_prior_art.title: MVPaint: Synchronized Multi-View Diffusion for Painting Anything 3D
external_prior_art.consequence: Representative multi-view texturing system with Objaverse/GSO benchmarks, component ablations, and human ratings of overall quality, seam visibility and consistency.

external_prior_art.title: Im2SurfTex: Surface Texture Generation via Neural Backprojection of Multi-View Images
external_prior_art.consequence: Venue-adjacent modular texture method; uses shared pipeline comparisons and component ablations to isolate a technical contribution.

external_prior_art.title: UniTex: Single-chart texture reconstruction from multi-view images
external_prior_art.consequence: Recent target-venue example that ties production-oriented claims to explicit reconstruction modules and artifact-level outcomes.

external_prior_art.title: MVPainter: Accurate and Detailed 3D Texture Generation via Multi-View Diffusion with Geometric Control
external_prior_art.consequence: The underlying system defines reference alignment, geometry-texture consistency and local texture quality as separate evaluation dimensions, with RGB/PBR comparisons, ablations and human-aligned evaluation; use it to distinguish pipeline claims from the scale-schedule revision.
